slice.title: Display supplier contact email in product list
slice.goal: Show the assigned supplier contact email in the product list, after supplier assignment, supplier name display, and supplier filtering already exist.
acceptance_criteria: Existing product create, edit, list, search, category filter, availability filter, supplier filter, supplier name display, Adjust Stock action, supplier creation, and product supplier selection behavior remains working.
Product list displays supplier contact email for products that have supplier_id assigned to an existing supplier with contact_email.
Products without assigned supplier display an empty fallback such as an em dash for supplier contact email.
When editing a product to select a different supplier, the product row updates to show the contact_email of the currently selected supplier.
Backend /api/products response includes supplier_contact_email or an equivalent response field that can be rendered by the product list.
Backend tests for supplier_contact_email use explicit shared test data/storage or provider composition so related lookup does not read a different supplier source.

Browser/e2e uses supplier ids and contact_email values returned by the current suppliers API or created runtime data; it does not assume a hard-coded first option remains the product's current supplier.
constraints: Use --from-run with a successful products-app-supplier-display-filter run as baseline, for example runs/run-011-products-supplier-display-filter.
Treat this as extend_existing_behavior: no new screens, applications, resources, or external integrations are required.
Do not create a second product catalog screen or separate product application.
Preserve supplier management widget, product supplier selection, supplier name display, and supplier filter from previous slices.
Do not recreate supplier creation inside the product contact display e2e; supplier creation is already covered by previous slices and may only be rerun as regression.
Do not change the Supplier model/schema. Use the existing contact_email field when present in the current Supplier model/API.
Do not rewrite existing valid supplier mock records only to change demo names, ids, or emails.
Do not modify backend/app/main.py or backend/app/storage/__init__.py for this slice unless existing validation proves wiring is missing.
If a product response field is needed for supplier contact email, include the owning Product model/DTO/schema file in the file plan rather than modifying it unexpectedly.
Related supplier contact resolution should use explicit dependency seams, provider composition, or shared test storage so backend tests do not read different mock files for related resources.
Extend existing backend/tests/test_products_api.py and frontend/e2e/products-crud-list-search.spec.js; do not create a new product_catalog.spec.js or duplicate product catalog browser spec.
No product delete, supplier delete, procurement workflows, authentication, database migrations, or new dependencies.
Continue using local JSON mock storage.
non_goals: Adding a new supplier filter or changing supplier filter semantics.
Changing supplier create/edit behavior beyond preserving previous supplier resource behavior.
Adding procurement, purchase order, contract, warehouse, supplier scoring, or external integration logic.
Adding validation that supplier contact email exists when selecting supplier; display fallback is acceptable for missing related data in this prototype.
validation_expectations: Extend backend product API tests to verify supplier_contact_email is returned for a product assigned to a supplier with contact_email.
Extend backend product API tests to verify supplier_contact_email updates when a product's supplier_id changes or when listing products after supplier assignment.
Extend existing product e2e to verify the product row displays the contact_email for the current assigned supplier.
Rerun existing supplier filter/name display/product regression behavior.

requirements.text: В списке продуктов отображается контактный email поставщика для продуктов, связанных с поставщиком.
notes: This slice starts from a successful supplier display/filter baseline: Product already has optional supplier_id, supplier_name display, and supplier filter behavior.
Supplier records must already be available through /api/suppliers or existing schema-compatible mock storage; this slice must not recreate supplier management or change the Supplier schema.
The contact email displayed for a product must come from the supplier currently assigned to that product, using real supplier ids/contact_email values from the current API or runtime test data.
If the product supplier is changed during edit, the displayed contact email must update to the newly selected supplier's contact_email.

scenario_notes: This scenario intentionally checks a small related display-field extension after multi-resource Product/Supplier flows are already implemented.
It should reuse current supplier ids/contact_email values from the baseline/API and should not create a new resource or new screen.
It is intended to exercise planning for response model ownership, provider composition, and browser tests using current runtime related values.
